title: HookKit Provider Evidence
description: One JSON evidence record per (provider version, architecture) pair, per spec section 14.2. Lives under metadata/provider-evidence/<family>/. Consumed by the engine certification process (spec section 8.7) — an engine mode backed by a provider without a matching, certified evidence record may not participate in automatic routing.

version.description: Exact version string, commit hash, or other unambiguous fingerprint identifying what was measured.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact vendored binary this evidence describes.

exported_abi.description: Exported symbol names this evidence exercised/relies on.

discovery_method.description: How the engine's discover() step (spec section 8.3) determines availability. Must be side-effect-free — dlopen/constructors/callback registration are never valid discovery methods.

constructor_behavior.description: unbounded_or_unknown must be reported as HK_EFFECT_UNKNOWN_PROCESS_MUTATION and can never satisfy HK_FORBID_UNKNOWN_*.

continuation_kind.description: Per spec section 14.3: calling the provider with old_ptr == NULL is NOT evidence of "none". provider_internal or unknown may never satisfy HK_CONTINUATION_FORBIDDEN, HK_CONTINUATION_NO_DYNAMIC_EXECUTABLE_MEMORY, HK_FORBID_UNKNOWN_PREPARATION_EFFECTS, or HK_FORBID_UNKNOWN_COMMIT_EFFECTS.

original_publication_order.description: unknown or after_activation makes this provider ineligible for any request needing HK_ORIGINAL_* per spec section 4.5.

verification_level.description: Never claim device_verified without an actual device run — spec section 32.

certification_status.description: Only device_certified providers back engine modes eligible for automatic routing (spec section 8.7). uncertified/host_certified are reachable only through the private test SPI.
